nameEn: Manufacture of electric motors, generators, transformers and electricity distribution and control apparatus
description: This class includes the manufacture of electric motors, generators, transformers and electricity distribution and control apparatus.
includes: manufacture of electric motors, except for starting motors of internal combustion engines
manufacture of transformers for power distribution and industrial use
manufacture of voltage regulators for power supply
manufacture of electricity distribution and control apparatus: switch-gear and switch-board apparatus, fuses, switches, lightning arrestors, voltage limiters, voltage surge suppressors
manufacture of welding apparatus, electric or laser
excludes: manufacture of electric motors for vehicles, see 2910
manufacture of starting motors for internal combustion engines, see 2930
manufacture of generators for bicycles (dynamos), see 3091
